thread:
maria: Heads up — seeing a spike of traces for /v1/infer where the root span exists but most DB/cache child spans are missing. ~5% of traces in the last hour. Anyone seen this?
kevin: same here, noticed around 03:10 UTC. example trace id: 4bf92f35...e4736.
sophia: which exporter/region? collector -> telemetry-exporter-us-east?
jay: ops-bot fired an alert about exporter queue spike at 03:14. might be related.
ops-bot: ALERT: exporter=otel-exporter-us-east queue_len=1123 dropped_spans=382 last_error="HTTP 429 from archive-storage" timestamp=2026-03-19T03:14:22Z
maria: I pulled headers from the ingress span. snippet: ```traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01
tracestate: vendor=xyz,rd=1
x-sampled: 1``` but requests between services (svc->db-proxy/cache) are missing traceparent.
kevin: our middleware should forward traceparent/tracestate. any recent router/nginx changes?
sophia: there was a router header-whitelist tweak in PR #5123 yesterday to drop some x- headers to avoid auth leaks. could have unintended side effects.
jay: also saw an adaptive-sampling canary rolled at 02:50 UTC that sets x-sampled instead of populating the sampling bit in traceparent. if we rely on traceparent for downstream, not forwarding x-sampled will break sampling propagation.
maria: exporter saturation -> sampling toggle -> header translation bug = child spans lost or ingested as orphans. that matches the symptom.
kevin: collector logs showing: ```2026-03-19T03:14:23Z WARN received orphan span id=7a3f... reason=sampling-missing
2026-03-19T03:14:23Z ERROR exporter flush failed status=429 dropped=22```
sophia: immediate mitigation: revert router whitelist PR and pause the adaptive-sampling canary. can we hotfix middleware to always forward traceparent/tracestate regardless of whitelist?
jay: yes, I can push a hotfix. plan: 1) kubectl rollout undo deploy/router -n ingress (canary off) 2) scale adaptive-sampling to 0 3) patch router to allow trace headers 4) increase exporter retry/backoff + bump buffer.
maria: commands: ```kubectl -n ingress rollout undo deployment/router --to-revision=153 && kubectl -n telemetry scale deploy/adaptive-sampling --replicas=0``` then run curl test: ```curl -sv -H "traceparent: 00-4bf92f35...-00f067...-01" https://edge.my.redwood/v1/infer``` confirm downstream sees header.
kevin: after rollback I still saw a few orphans but dropped span count rapidly decreased. exporter metrics show queue draining.
sophia: follow-up items: add integration test to ensure router preserves traceparent/tracestate; update PR checklist to whitelist trace headers explicitly; add metric for "orphan_span_rate" to collector dashboards.
jay: hotfix deployed to canary -> rolling to 100% now. will monitor queues & orphan log.
deploy-bot: Deployment router rollback started by jay at 2026-03-19T03:23:10Z.
ops-bot: exporter queue length dropped to 120, dropped_spans last_min=4, orphan_log_hits down 95% (03:38 UTC) :thumbsup:
maria: reopening postmortem ticket and assigning owners. thanks all — good catch on the header translation.
kevin: +1, let's follow up with a short blameless postmortem and add a guardrail in the rollout UX for sampling changes.
sophia: will own the integration test and dashboard changes.
jay: will write the router hotfix PR and link the canary runbook.
maria: adding notes to the incident: root cause = adaptive-sampling canary + router header whitelist + exporter backpressure, mitigation = rollback + header-forward hotfix + exporter backoff, next actions = tests + dashboards + rollout UX change.
